changes.text: Shorten the homepage's combined saved-note and task-export description.
Describe submitted features in the present tense and combine clipboard, saved-note editing, and optional task exports into one homepage step; make this the default release copy policy.
Explain saved-note editing and optional Apple Reminders or Things tasks in the main App Store description, and show Settings last in the iPhone and iPad screenshot sets.
Require verified App Store review submission before merging the release PR or deploying the website, while preserving resumable submission records if website publication fails.
Use Apple's supported iPhone screenshot display identifier, including when resuming already-reviewed plans, without changing captured images or upload receipts.
